Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: A school subject folder created by a student to organize notes and reviewers.

name.description: Display name of the subject (1-60 chars).

colorTag.description: Pink-palette accent tag for the subject.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and updates.

StudyNote.title: StudyNote
StudyNote.description: A student note containing editable extracted text from photos, tagged photo preview, highlighted phrases, and key definitions.

subjectId.description: ID of the parent Subject document.

extractedText.description: Editable text extracted from printed pages, handwriting, or typed directly.

photoTag.description: Short tag identifying the source photo or page (0-80 chars).

thumbnailBase64.description: Compact compressed JPEG preview thumbnail encoded in base64 (0-120000 chars).

highlights.description: Highlighted phrases or sentences marked right on screen (max 40).

definitions.description: Extracted or manually highlighted key term and definition objects (max 40).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and updates.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Student-owned extracted notes, tagged photos, highlights, and key definitions.
